leadText:
JUMP UP is the second ending theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon Journeys: The Series. It debuted in JN061, replacing Memorizing Pokémon Names. Unlike previous Korean ending themes, it uses various episode clips from Pokémon Journeys: The Series, containing no footage from its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Pokémon Shiritori. 

The song was uploaded to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on October 14, 2021.
